item.title: Bishop Moore boys soccer gives coach another shot at FHSAA state title
item.description: Bishop Moore coach Tom Hage has never won a state title, although he has guided his team to seven straight final-four appearances. After the Hornets 2-0 victory over Naples in the semifinals on Thursday night, he has another shot.
